genomes.name: A1 Red Day Near Mean
genomes.thesis: 5% down day within 3% of the 20-day mean on volume; +3% or two bars.

entry_rules.when: ret1 < -0.05 and close > sma20 * 0.97 and volume_ratio > 1.2

genomes.name: A2 Red Day, Green Exit
genomes.thesis: Same entry; out after the first green close, at most three bars.

entry_rules.when: ret1 < -0.05 and close > sma20 * 0.97 and volume_ratio > 1.2

genomes.name: A3 Red Day, Lower Half
genomes.thesis: Same entry plus a close in the lower half of the day's range.

entry_rules.when: ret1 < -0.05 and close > sma20 * 0.97 and volume_ratio > 1.2 and (close - low) / (high - low + 0.0001) < 0.5

genomes.name: B1 Capitulation Close
genomes.thesis: 4% down, closing in the bottom quarter of the range, on 1.3x volume.

entry_rules.when: ret1 < -0.04 and (close - low) / (high - low + 0.0001) < 0.25 and volume_ratio > 1.3

genomes.name: B2 Capitulation, Not Collapsing
genomes.thesis: Capitulation candle, but only while still within 10% of the 50-day mean.

entry_rules.when: ret1 < -0.04 and (close - low) / (high - low + 0.0001) < 0.25 and volume_ratio > 1.3 and close > sma50 * 0.90

genomes.name: B3 Capitulation, Bottom 15%
genomes.thesis: Tighter candle filter: close in the bottom 15% of the range.

entry_rules.when: ret1 < -0.04 and (close - low) / (high - low + 0.0001) < 0.15 and volume_ratio > 1.3

genomes.name: B4 Capitulation -3%
genomes.thesis: Looser trigger: a 3% down day with the candle and volume filters.

entry_rules.when: ret1 < -0.03 and (close - low) / (high - low + 0.0001) < 0.25 and volume_ratio > 1.3

genomes.name: B5 Capitulation, 1-Bar
genomes.thesis: Capitulation candle, out at the open after one full bar.

entry_rules.when: ret1 < -0.04 and (close - low) / (high - low + 0.0001) < 0.25 and volume_ratio > 1.3

genomes.name: B6 Capitulation, Target Only
genomes.thesis: Capitulation candle; exit only on a 3% target or the two-bar clock.

entry_rules.when: ret1 < -0.04 and (close - low) / (high - low + 0.0001) < 0.25 and volume_ratio > 1.3

genomes.name: C1 Red Day Above 50
genomes.thesis: 5% down day with the fund still above its 50-day mean.

entry_rules.when: ret1 < -0.05 and close > sma50 and volume_ratio > 1.0

genomes.name: C2 Red Day -4% Above 50
genomes.thesis: Looser trigger above the 50-day mean.

entry_rules.when: ret1 < -0.04 and close > sma50 and volume_ratio > 1.0

genomes.name: C3 Red Day Above 50, Volume
genomes.thesis: Above the 50-day with a 1.2x volume gate.

entry_rules.when: ret1 < -0.05 and close > sma50 and volume_ratio > 1.2

genomes.name: C4 Red Day Above 50, 3-Bar
genomes.thesis: Above the 50-day; +5% target or three bars.

entry_rules.when: ret1 < -0.05 and close > sma50 and volume_ratio > 1.0

genomes.name: D1 RSI7 < 40 Above 50
genomes.thesis: Multi-day oversold on a 7-bar RSI in an uptrend; out on the snap or three bars.

entry_rules.when: rsi7 < 40 and close > sma50

genomes.name: D2 RSI7 < 35 Above 50, Target
genomes.thesis: Same oversold entry with a 4% target instead of an RSI exit.

entry_rules.when: rsi7 < 35 and close > sma50

genomes.name: D3 RSI7 < 35 Above 20
genomes.thesis: Oversold gated on the 20-day mean instead of the 50.

entry_rules.when: rsi7 < 35 and close > sma20

genomes.name: E1 Week Slide
genomes.thesis: An 8% five-day slide that has not broken the 50-day mean; +3% or two bars.

entry_rules.when: ret5 < -0.08 and close > sma50 * 0.97

genomes.name: E2 Week Slide, Oversold
genomes.thesis: A 10% five-day slide, oversold, still near the 50-day.

entry_rules.when: ret5 < -0.10 and rsi7 < 40 and close > sma50 * 0.95

genomes.name: F1 Band Touch
genomes.thesis: Close at or under the lower band near the 50-day; +3% or two bars.

entry_rules.when: bb_pct < 0.05 and close > sma50 * 0.97

genomes.name: F2 Band Break on Volume
genomes.thesis: Close under the lower band on 1.2x volume, any regime.

entry_rules.when: bb_pct < 0.0 and volume_ratio > 1.2

genomes.name: G1 ATR Drop 1.5
genomes.thesis: A 1.5-ATR down day near the 20-day mean on volume; out at one ATR or two bars.

entry_rules.when: ret1 < -1.5 * atr_pct and close > sma20 * 0.97 and volume_ratio > 1.2

genomes.name: H1 Pullback Cluster, Fast
genomes.thesis: Two red closes and a 3% five-day loss in an uptrend; +3% or two bars.

entry_rules.when: ret1 < 0 and prev(ret1) < 0 and ret5 < -0.03 and close > sma50 and volume_ratio > 1.1
